integrity: The analytic proof covers every positive weight. Finite exact-arithmetic and floating-point LP tests are corroboration, not an independent proof or scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: Applies to scalar real homogeneous weighted edge total variation on the height-two full binary tree with equal weights within each depth; it does not cover higher depths or nonlinear trace extension problems. Earlier equivalent projection-constant results remain possible.
title: Sharp endpoint linear trace extensions on a two-generation weighted binary tree
